title: What It Really Costs to Own a Ram TRX
description:
The new Ram TRX starts at about one hundred thousand dollars. Edmunds estimates that five years of owning the previous one costs one hundred two thousand, two hundred eight dollars. And the biggest line in that estimate is not the price of the truck, it is the fuel. This is what it really costs to own a Ram TRX, with every number sourced, and with the places where nobody has published one. We read Edmunds, Kelley Blue Book, the Energy Information Administration, the federal recall database, tyre retailers, Ram's own releases, and several magazines. Edmunds and Kelley Blue Book are estimates, not receipts. Where we do the arithmetic, it is labelled as ours, and where there is no published number, we say so.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
